title: Credit Memo on Crop Insurance Support — Post-Split Limit for Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When a member asks to split the farmstead out of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the post-split limit follows the member's Crop Insurance: with a crop insurance policy in active status whose indemnity is assigned to the association it is 2.5 points higher; with a crop insurance policy in active status and none of them assigned it is 1.0 point higher; otherwise it is not changed.

**What the records show.** The member's Crop Insurance policy records: each policy's status and whether its indemnity is assigned to the association.

| Member's Crop Insurance policies | Change to the post-split limit |
|---|---|
| At least one policy in active status with its indemnity assigned to the association | 2.5 points higher |
| One or more policies in active status, none assigned | 1.0 point higher |
| No policy in active status | no change |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A member with an active Revenue Protection policy on corn whose indemnity is assigned, and an unassigned active policy on soybeans: at least one active policy is assigned, so 2.5 points higher.
- A member whose only active policy is unassigned: 1.0 point higher.
- A member whose only policy is not in active status: no change.

On a product whose largest principal after a release is 75 percent, the limit becomes 77.5 percent with an assigned active policy and 76 percent with only unassigned active policies.
